answer_1.quote: Takin-VC, a novel expressive zero-shot VC framework that delivers advanced modeling of content, timbre, and speech quality in a zero-shot fashion.
answer_1.outputs: target speech with converted timbre while preserving linguistic and paralinguistic content

answer_2.quote: For objective metrics, we employ word error rate (WER), UTMOS, and speaker embedding cosine similarity (SECS) to evaluate the intelligibility, quality, and speaker similarity.

answer_4.quote: We invite 20 professional participants to listen to the generated samples and provide their subjective perception scores on a 5-point scale
answer_4.guideline: naturalness mean opinion score (NMOS) to evaluate the naturalness of the generated samples and similarity mean opinion scores (SMOS) to evaluate the speaker similarity
